name: Claude Code Gates
description: Directory-based modular gate modules for Claude Code sessions in OpenClaw. Drop-in .js modules for git safety, secret scanning, code quality, commit hygiene, disk safety, AI behavioral guardrails, auto-continue enforcement, and session start reminders.
author: grobomo

modules.description: Flat enable/disable for individual gate modules (fallback when modules.yaml is absent). Keyed by module name.
